lines.zh: 我用整只头看路，身体跟在后面
lines.en: My whole head does the seeing; the body just follows.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛先行一步，身体才追上来
lines.en: My eye arrives first; the rest of me catches up.

lines.zh: 三条同类在前，我跟着那只最大的眼
lines.en: Three of us ahead; I follow the largest eye.

lines.zh: 末地石从眼下流过，像灰色的河
lines.en: End stone streams beneath my eye like a grey river.

lines.zh: 我不摆尾，我只让眼睛转过去
lines.en: I do not flick my tail; I turn my eye.

lines.zh: 虚空在下面很远，我在上面游
lines.en: The void lies far below; I swim above it.

lines.zh: 那一片紫色没有底，我认得路
lines.en: That purple has no floor, yet I know the way.

lines.zh: 五颗眼珠一起漂，像一串灯
lines.en: Five eyeballs drift together like a string of lamps.

lines.zh: 我避开岛边，那里没有水给我
lines.en: I keep off the island's edge; no water waits there.

lines.zh: 别看我小，我游得比水快一点
lines.en: Small as I am, I outswim the water itself.

lines.zh: 我的鳍很小，眼睛替我用力
lines.en: My fins are small; my eye does the rowing.

lines.zh: 一整群眼睛转向同一边，我也转
lines.en: The whole school turns one way; so do I.

lines.zh: 我在末地的暗处找一条空的路
lines.en: I look for an empty lane in the End's dark.

lines.zh: 我游得很稳，因为路是我看出来的
lines.en: My path is steady because my eye carves it.

lines.zh: 我跟着前头那颗大眼走
lines.en: I follow the big eye ahead of me

lines.zh: 末地的水不多，我挑着游
lines.en: End water is scarce, so I pick my way

lines.zh: 紫光从眼角掠过，我没停
lines.en: Violet light slides past my eye; I do not stop

lines.zh: 一群眼睛从我旁边错开
lines.en: A school of eyes slides past me

lines.zh: 我停在水里，只把眼珠慢慢转
lines.en: I hold still and turn my eye, slowly.

lines.zh: 不游的时候，我也在看
lines.en: Even at rest, I am watching.

lines.zh: 眼睛闭上就是睡着，没有别的办法
lines.en: To close my eye is to sleep; no other way.

lines.zh: 末地没有白天，我的眼也不眨
lines.en: The End has no day; my eye never blinks.

lines.zh: 我在想事情，想事情就是用眼看
lines.en: Thinking, for me, is simply looking.

lines.zh: 水面很静，我的瞳孔在放大
lines.en: The water is still; my pupil widens.

lines.zh: 一颗眼珠浮着，像没系住的灯
lines.en: An eye floats here, a lamp untied.

lines.zh: 我数同类的眼，一共四颗
lines.en: I count my schoolmates' eyes: four in all.

lines.zh: 有东西在水外动，我不动
lines.en: Something moves beyond the water; I do not.

lines.zh: 我等一条鱼先犯错，再动
lines.en: I wait for a fish to err first.

lines.zh: 光从上面漏下来，我的眼接住它
lines.en: Light leaks from above; my eye catches it.

lines.zh: 静下来时，我才听得见虚空
lines.en: Only in stillness do I hear the void.

lines.zh: 我的身体只是眼睛的架子
lines.en: My body is only a frame for the eye.

lines.zh: 我记得上次日落是什么样子，很久了
lines.en: I remember the last sunset. It was long ago.

lines.zh: 你先被我的眼看住，才看见我
lines.en: My eye finds you before you find me.

lines.zh: 我把你从头看到脚，一次看完
lines.en: I read you head to toe in one look.

lines.zh: 你的手里有鱼竿，我看见了
lines.en: There is a rod in your hand. I see it.

lines.zh: 你挡住了光，我的瞳孔缩了一下
lines.en: You block the light; my pupil tightens.

lines.zh: 别挥手，我只认形状不认手势
lines.en: Skip the waving; I read shapes, not gestures.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，你也在被记住
lines.en: While I watch you, you are being remembered.

lines.zh: 你站在末地石上，离水太远了
lines.en: You stand on end stone, too far from water.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水里，比你先到
lines.en: Your shadow reaches the water before you do.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，看你就够了
lines.en: One eye is all I have, and enough for you.

lines.zh: 你眨眼两次，我只眨一次
lines.en: You blink twice; I blink once.

lines.zh: 我的眼被水震了一下，很疼
lines.en: The water shook my eye; it hurts.

lines.zh: 别打头，头就是我的全部
lines.en: Not the head; the head is all of me.

lines.zh: 我缩起鳍，把眼转向你
lines.en: I fold my fins and turn my eye on you.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记清了你的脸
lines.en: Pain carves your face somewhere behind my eye.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，像一小片晚霞
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water like a small sunset.

lines.zh: 我疼的时候不叫，只是睁大眼
lines.en: In pain I do not cry out; I widen my eye.

lines.zh: 三点生命，经不起你第二下
lines.en: Three hearts will not survive your second hit.

lines.zh: 我退到石头缝里，眼还露在外面
lines.en: I back into a crevice, eye still showing.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，也打中了我看你的方式
lines.en: You hit me, and hit the way I see you.

lines.zh: 疼过之后，我游得更快
lines.en: After the pain, I swim faster.

lines.zh: 钩上的饵在动，我的眼先动了
lines.en: The bait twitches; my eye moves first.

lines.zh: 我知道那是陷阱，可我还是靠近
lines.en: I know it is a trap. I come closer anyway.

lines.zh: 一条虫在水里扭，我的脑子也在扭
lines.en: A worm wriggles; so does my mind.

lines.zh: 我看得太清楚，反而看不清危险
lines.en: I see it too clearly to see the danger.

lines.zh: 饵的颜色比末地石好看多了
lines.en: The bait's color beats end stone by far.

lines.zh: 我围着钩转，用眼睛量它的距离
lines.en: I circle the hook, measuring it with my eye.

lines.zh: 你在等我自己犯错，我在等饵动
lines.en: You wait for my mistake; I wait for the bait.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我的眼比胃更急
lines.en: I am hungry, but my eye is greedier.

lines.zh: 那股味道穿过水，直冲我的瞳孔
lines.en: That smell crosses the water straight to my pupil.

lines.zh: 别拉线，让我再多看一眼
lines.en: Do not pull yet; let me look once more.

lines.zh: 你碰到的是眼珠，不是鱼身
lines.en: You touched an eyeball, not a fish.

lines.zh: 我的身子只有四分之一格宽
lines.en: My body is barely a quarter block wide.

lines.zh: 那一下很轻，我还是往旁边躲
lines.en: It was a light touch, and I still flinch aside.

lines.zh: 眼睛被撞到，会疼很久
lines.en: Bumping the eye aches for a long while.

lines.zh: 我的皮很薄，隔着水也能感到你
lines.en: My skin is thin; I feel you through water.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，我的瞳孔缩成针
lines.en: Too close now; my pupil narrows to a needle.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的靴子，像撞上一堵墙
lines.en: I hit your boot like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 别用手指碰，我的眼会记仇
lines.en: Do not poke it; my eye holds grudges.

lines.zh: 这点重量，水一推我就偏了
lines.en: I am light enough for the water to shove.

lines.zh: 我退开半格，眼睛还盯着你
lines.en: I back off half a block, eye still on you.

lines.zh: 两只眼对着看，就是我们的婚礼
lines.en: Two eyes facing each other: that is the wedding.

lines.zh: 我们不碰鳍，只交换一个长久的注视
lines.en: We never touch fins, only trade a long look.

lines.zh: 它的眼比我的亮，我选它
lines.en: Its eye shines brighter than mine; I choose it.

lines.zh: 五条鱼围成圈，中间是我们两个
lines.en: Five fish circle us; we two hold the middle.

lines.zh: 水里没有花，我把光让给它
lines.en: No flowers here; I give it the light instead.

lines.zh: 我们的眼睛颜色一样，这就够了
lines.en: Our eyes are the same shade. That is enough.

lines.zh: 它的瞳孔转过来，我的心跳跟着转
lines.en: Its pupil turns; my pulse turns with it.

lines.zh: 交配时我们也睁着眼，从不闭上
lines.en: Even now our eyes stay open, never shut.

lines.zh: 我绕着它游三圈，算是答应了
lines.en: I circle it three times; that is my yes.

lines.zh: 后代会有更大的眼睛，我确定
lines.en: Our young will have bigger eyes. I am sure.

lines.zh: 我没有手，掉下来的东西留在地上
lines.en: No hands on me; what falls stays fallen.

lines.zh: 那只鱼竿我捡不起来，只能看
lines.en: I cannot lift that rod, only stare at it.

lines.zh: 掉进水的木头会漂，我会绕开
lines.en: Wood floats when it falls; I swim around it.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我用眼称它的重量
lines.en: Something sinks; my eye weighs it for me.

lines.zh: 我试过用嘴叼，那一口只是咬
lines.en: I tried carrying with my mouth; it was a bite.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉在末地石上，太远了
lines.en: Your thing fell on end stone, out of reach.

lines.zh: 我不要那些，我只要水里的虫
lines.en: I want none of that; only the worms.

lines.zh: 桶口亮了一下，我知道那是什么
lines.en: The bucket glints; I know what it is.

lines.zh: 眼睛看见的，不必都归我
lines.en: Not everything my eye sees must be mine.

lines.zh: 我推了一下那块石头，它没动
lines.en: I nudged the stone; it did not move.

lines.zh: 我的眼锁住你了，跑也没用
lines.en: My eye has you now; running will not help.

lines.zh: 水纹一变，我就知道该盯谁
lines.en: The ripples shift; I know who to watch.

lines.zh: 那只饵落水的声音，比雷还清
lines.en: That bait's splash is clearer than thunder.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的手，不是你的脸
lines.en: Your hands hold the rod; those are what I watch.

lines.zh: 一个影子在水面晃，我记下了
lines.en: A shadow sways on the surface; noted.

lines.zh: 我选了最小的那个目标，好对付
lines.en: I pick the smallest target; it is easier.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔对准了，接下来是等
lines.en: My pupil is aligned; now I wait.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了水边的石头，我先听到了
lines.en: You broke stone by the water; I heard first.

lines.zh: 那根线在动，线的那头是人
lines.en: The line moves, and a person holds its end.

lines.zh: 锁定一个人要多久？我只要一眼
lines.en: How long to fix on you? One glance.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不近也不远
lines.en: I trail you, neither near nor far.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的眼就转到哪
lines.en: Wherever you go, my eye turns after.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只是不快也不慢地跟着
lines.en: I do not chase; I simply keep pace.

lines.zh: 你以为我走了，其实我在你影子里
lines.en: You think I left; I am in your shadow.

lines.zh: 线越收越短，我的心越跳越快
lines.en: The line shortens; my heart hurries.

lines.zh: 水挡不住视线，只让影子变形
lines.en: Water does not stop sight, only bends shadows.

lines.zh: 我在数你的脚步，一共十七下
lines.en: I am counting your steps: seventeen so far.

lines.zh: 你一停，我也停，眼还开着
lines.en: You stop; I stop, eye still open.

lines.zh: 我绕着钩打转，等你手抖
lines.en: I circle the hook, waiting for your hand to shake.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头你会看见我
lines.en: Do not look back; you would see me.

lines.zh: 我撞你的脚踝，用整只头
lines.en: I ram your ankle with my entire head.

lines.zh: 这一口很小，但我的眼一直张着
lines.en: A small bite, but my eye never shuts.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打，我擅长被看见
lines.en: Fighting is not my skill; being seen is.

lines.zh: 你被一颗眼珠顶了一下，别嫌轻
lines.en: An eyeball butted you; do not call it light.

lines.zh: 我用嘴咬住你的袖口，然后滑开
lines.en: I bite your sleeve, then slip away.

lines.zh: 撞击是我唯一会的词
lines.en: Colliding is the only word I know.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，但我记得你的位置
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I keep your position.

lines.zh: 那点力气，只够把你的水面弄乱
lines.en: Just enough force to ruin your calm water.

lines.zh: 我的攻击是想让你退一步
lines.en: My attack is only meant to make you step back.

lines.zh: 眼睛亮了一下，那就是我要出手了
lines.en: My eye brightens; that is my warning.

lines.zh: 我从末地的暗处被吐出来
lines.en: The End's dark spits me out.

lines.zh: 一睁眼，世界就已经在看我
lines.en: I open my eye, and the world is already looking.

lines.zh: 三条同类落在我旁边，一起漂
lines.en: Three kin drop beside me and drift along.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见虚空，就学会了游
lines.en: I saw the void once and learned to swim.

lines.zh: 末地石很冷，我的眼先醒了
lines.en: End stone is cold; my eye wakes first.

lines.zh: 我从无底的地方来，带着一只眼
lines.en: I come from the bottomless place, carrying an eye.

lines.zh: 出生时我不叫，我只是张开瞳孔
lines.en: I did not cry at birth; I opened my pupil.

lines.zh: 紫色的天压在头上，我照旧游
lines.en: Purple sky presses down; I swim as usual.

lines.zh: 这一片水域没有名字，我给它看
lines.en: This water has no name; I give it my gaze.

lines.zh: 我来的地方没有光，所以我自带一只
lines.en: My birthplace had no light, so I brought an eye.

lines.zh: 火会先煮熟我，再杀死我
lines.en: Fire cooks me through before it kills me.

lines.zh: 我从水里被摔到石头上，眼还睁着
lines.en: Dropped from water onto stone, my eye stays open.

lines.zh: 我住在水里，却也会被水淹死
lines.en: I live in water, yet water can drown me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的眼照得一片白
lines.en: The blast turns my eye blinding white.

lines.zh: 箭从水上飞来，我看见了它
lines.en: The arrow came over the water; I saw it.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进我的眼，那里没有地方躲
lines.en: Magic crawls into my eye; there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 饿久了的眼，看什么都像虫
lines.en: A starved eye sees worms in everything.

lines.zh: 雷落在水上，我的瞳孔全是白光
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water; my pupil floods with white.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吞下去，连眼也不剩
lines.en: The void swallows me, eye and all.
